name: Battledancing (Combat, Mythic)
body:
Nothing can hinder your flowing movements in combat.

Prerequisite: Battledancing.

Benefits: You can use Battledancing when wearing any type of armor. If you are wearing armor that’s made mostly of cloth, the total bonus from Battledancing increases to +4 and you can divide it as you like among 2, 3, or 4 opponents.
